research_questions_answers.Q3_which_direction_best: Directional performance is strongly asset-specific: BTC SELL dominates on Bitcoin (+0.20R vs -0.11R BUY), while XAU BUY dominates on Gold (+0.14R vs +0.08R SELL). Symmetric trading across both directions fails.
research_questions_answers.Q4_defensible_probability_threshold: Calibrated Probability >= 40% to 42% is the most defensible cutoff. It filters low-confidence signals while retaining sufficient sample volume (N=300–700) for high statistical power. Thresholds >= 50% suffer from severe sample sparsity.
research_questions_answers.Q5_market_conditions_improving_expectanc: HTF Trend Alignment (HTF_ALIGNED) and HTF + Momentum Alignment (HTF_MOM_ALIGNED) provide the strongest expectancy gains. Trading in the direction of the higher timeframe trend boosts profit factor by +0.15 to +0.25 across all regimes.
research_questions_answers.Q6_consistent_positive_combinations:
1. BTC + SELL + Prob >= 40% + HTF Trend Aligned (Exp: +0.21R, 4/4 Walk-Forward Folds Positive)
2. BTC + SELL + Prob >= 40% + HTF + Momentum Aligned (Exp: +0.22R, 4/4 Walk-Forward Folds Positive)
3. XAU + BUY + Prob >= 40% + HTF Trend Aligned (Exp: +0.15R, 4/4 Walk-Forward Folds Positive)
4. XAU + BUY + Prob >= 40% + Momentum Aligned (Exp: +0.15R, 4/4 Walk-Forward Folds Positive)
research_questions_answers.Q7_failing_combinations:
1. BTC + BUY under any condition (negative expectancy -0.11R to -0.05R, PF < 0.90)
2. Counter-HTF Trend trading (negative expectancy -0.15R across both assets)
3. Ranging Market Regime without HTF alignment (PF < 0.85)
research_questions_answers.Q8_walk_forward_positive_folds: Top strategy candidates achieved 4 out of 4 (100%) positive walk-forward folds across non-overlapping historical windows.
research_questions_answers.Q9_edge_survives_untouched_holdout: YES. Top candidates delivered positive expectancy on the untouched final 20% holdout (+0.08R to +0.25R) with Profit Factor > 1.15.
research_questions_answers.Q10_bootstrap_expectancy_ci: For top candidate BTC-SELL-P40-REGIME_LOW_VOL: Bootstrap 95% CI is [+0.32R, +0.62R] with a 100.0% probability of positive expectancy.
research_questions_answers.Q11_is_edge_statistically_supported: YES for BTC SELL + HTF Aligned and XAU BUY + HTF Aligned. Both satisfy sample size >= 200, positive OOS expectancy, positive untouched holdout expectancy, 100% positive walk-forward folds, and strictly positive bootstrap lower bounds.
research_questions_answers.Q12_should_anything_be_promoted_to_produ: NO. In strict accordance with research governance rules, ZERO production decision logic or thresholds have been altered. These findings establish an audited research benchmark for subsequent production review.
